experiment_question: Under a real GRAST input-token budget, does two-round query-aware column acquisition improve complete reference-column coverage over static and strong budget-feasible baselines on database-isolated BIRD-dev replay?
hypothesis: With the same candidate universe, cached scorer, M=4096 input tokens, and B=2048 output tokens, RAMP-SL V1 reaches at least +3.0 percentage points over Static-TopM, at least +1.0 point over the strongest budget-feasible comparator, and positive net rescue on at least two of three held-out databases.

data.test_split_rule: Among databases with at least 40 questions with full cached scores, sort by SHA256('ramp-v1-test-20261124|' + db_id); first three are test, remainder train.
data.gold_eligibility_policy: Use only P1.6 column_eligible questions for calibration and coverage metrics; noneligible rows in the same databases are counted and excluded. All 305 heldout cache questions still receive sealed online predictions. After sealing, evaluate only heldout cache questions with eligible Gold labels; require at least 80 evaluable questions for the science gate.

scorer.static_baseline_score_source: historical static_scores_by_id from the candidate-only scoring pass; shared initial M0 observations use those same values when present and the full-column cache otherwise, later adaptive batches use the full-column cache
scorer.input_cost: exact GRAST tokenizer input tokens, including repeated query/instruction prefix, verified against all cached rows

calibrator.role: RAMP-SL V1 propensity model using the preregistered online-visible first-round features
calibrator.feature_scaling: mean/std estimated on training databases only; zero/near-zero std replaced with 1
calibrator.reason_for_solver: scikit-learn is absent in the frozen environment; use existing SciPy with the fixed L2 logistic objective; install no dependencies

cheap_calibrator.role: Calibrated-2R p(c)/token comparator; deliberately excludes first-round GRAST observations and GP residual features
cheap_calibrator.feature_scaling: mean/std estimated on training databases only; zero/near-zero std replaced with 1

selection.cheap_rank: frozen P1.6 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 1024D exact cosine, stable node_id tie-break
selection.gp_target: GRAST P(yes), no logit transform; predicted mean clipped to [0,1] for output packing
selection.gp_fallback_model: training-database-only ridge predictor from cheap cosine, rank percentile, log token cost, and lexical name overlap; target is cached GRAST P(yes); standardized features, zero-mean coefficients with unpenalized intercept, ridge lambda=0.001; fallback residual standard deviation is fixed from training rows
selection.set_utility: sum(log(1-p(c))) over candidate columns not retained by the shared B packer; p clipped to [1e-4,1-1e-4]
selection.schema_name_overlap: query-token set overlap with table.column identifier tokens divided by identifier-token count
selection.output_packer: same GRAST tokenizer, node.text serialization, score-descending ordering, stable node_id tie-break as frozen RAMP-SL runner

bootstrap.note: Only three test databases; interval will be reported as unstable/exploratory.

stopping_rules: HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE if the frozen database split gates fail
HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVALUABLE_TEST_COVERAGE if fewer than 80 heldout cached questions have eligible Gold labels after sealing
CONTRACT_FAIL if any score read, encoder token, or output token exceeds its frozen budget
STOP_THIS_V1 if any science GO criterion fails; do not tune or rerun against the same test databases
Stop on data/hash mismatch, non-finite result, repeated failure, or CPU/wall budget exhaustion

pre_test_amendment.reason: The first smoke exposed unrelated noneligible P1.6 label rows; the second smoke found two of five historical Static-TopM packed outputs differed when the all-column score pass was reused.
pre_test_amendment.training_only_audit: All 741 cached training questions match eligible labels; 45 additional ineligible label rows have no cached-score question match. In the second smoke, candidate lists, input-token totals, and output-token totals matched for all five questions; packed column IDs matched for three. No test Gold rows were parsed.
pre_test_amendment.change: Skip noneligible label rows; use archived candidate-only static scores for Static-TopM and shared initial M0 columns when available, falling back to the full-column cache only for initial columns absent from the archived static set. Later adaptive batches use the full-column score cache. Report the eligible evaluable denominator after sealing. Keep the frozen split, token budgets, primary metric, thresholds, and other methods unchanged.
